data.name: Tray_Tooltip
data.comment: The notification-area icon's tooltip.

data.name: Menu_Open
data.comment: Tray menu; _ marks the access key.

data.name: Menu_CheckForUpdates
data.comment: Tray menu: checks now and opens the Updates page.

data.name: Page_ComingLater
data.comment: The placeholder line on the pages that arrive later in v3.1.

data.name: Updates_Description
data.value: Once a day, RST asks GitHub whether a newer RST, Gantt-It or Splash-It is out, and tells you when one is.

data.name: Apps_Description
data.value: RST, Gantt-It and Splash-It: which are installed for you on this PC, and the latest version of each.

data.name: AddIns_Description
data.value: Choose the add-ins Revit loads before you start Revit. Until then, use the Profile Loader in Revit.

data.name: Settings_ThemeHint
data.value: System follows your Windows app theme.

data.name: Settings_CheckForUpdatesHint
data.value: Once a day, RST asks GitHub whether a newer RST, Gantt-It or Splash-It is available. It sends nothing about you or your models, and installs nothing until you click.

data.name: Settings_CheckForUpdatesLocked
data.value: Turned off on this computer by whoever manages its software.
data.comment: Shown when the UpdateChecks=0 registry preset forces checks off.

data.name: Settings_SaveFailed
data.value: Couldn't save the setting. Details are in the log.

data.name: Settings_VersionFormat
data.comment: {0} is the version, e.g. 3.1.0.

data.name: Settings_StartupHint
data.value: RST starts when you sign in to Windows. To stop that, turn RST off in Task Manager under Startup apps.

data.name: Footer_RunsInTray
data.value: RST keeps running in the notification area. Quit it from the icon's menu.

data.name: Notice_Message
data.value:
Once a day, the RST tray asks GitHub whether a newer RST, Gantt-It or Splash-It is available, and tells you when one is. It sends nothing about you or your models, and it installs nothing until you click Install.
To turn this off, open RST from the notification area and go to Settings.
data.comment: The one-time first-run notice (the telemetry ConsentNotice precedent).

data.name: Updates_LastCheckedToday
data.comment: {0} is the local time, e.g. 09:14.

data.name: Updates_LastCheckedYesterday
data.comment: {0} is the local time, e.g. 09:14.

data.name: Updates_LastCheckedOn
data.comment: {0} is the local date (28 Oct 2026), {1} the local time.

data.name: Updates_RstAvailable
data.comment: {0} is the latest version, e.g. 3.1.1.

data.name: Updates_RstInstalled
data.comment: The headline when the latest version is not known yet. {0} is the installed version.

data.name: Updates_RstUnknown
data.comment: The headline when RST's installed version is not known (not installed by RST.msi, e.g. a developer build).

data.name: Updates_ChecksOff
data.value: Automatic checks are off. Check now asks GitHub once, only when you click it.

data.name: Updates_ChecksOffLocked
data.value: Automatic checks were turned off on this computer by whoever manages its software. Check now still asks GitHub when you click it.

data.name: Updates_CheckFailed
data.value: Couldn't check: {0}. RST tries again at the next daily check. Details are in the log.
data.comment: {0} is why, e.g. "no answer in 30 s" or "HTTP 407".

data.name: Updates_LastSuccessToday
data.comment: Shown after a failed check. {0} is the local time.

data.name: Apps_DetectionFailed
data.value: Couldn't read the installed apps from Windows Installer, so their state is unknown. Details are in the log.

data.name: App_LatestFailedKnown
data.comment: {0} is the last known latest version, kept after a failed check.

data.name: State_Unknown
data.comment: Windows Installer could not be read for this app.

data.name: Updates_InstallComingSoon
data.value: Installing from RST is coming soon. For now, download the new version from its release page.

data.name: Apps_InstallsComingSoon
data.value: Install and Update are coming soon. For now, get each app from its release page.

data.name: App_InstalledForYou
data.comment: {0} is the installed version. A per-user install.

data.name: App_InstalledForYouManaged
data.comment: {0} is the installed version. A per-user install made by Group Policy.

data.name: App_InstalledForEveryone
data.comment: {0} is the installed version. A per-machine install.

data.name: App_ManualNote
data.value: Installed manually: updates not managed by RST.
data.comment: Shown when the add-in's .addin is present but Windows Installer has no product for it.

data.name: App_ComingSoon
data.comment: Beside the disabled Install and Update buttons (installs arrive in F17 WU4).

data.name: State_Installed
data.comment: Installed, the latest version not known yet.

data.name: Notify_OneTitle
data.comment: The tray notification. {0} the product (RST), {1} the version (3.1.1).

data.name: Notify_OneText
data.value: Click to see it in RST.

data.name: Notify_ManyTitle
data.comment: The tray notification when one check finds several new versions.

data.name: Notify_ManyText
data.value: {0}. Click to see them in RST.
data.comment: {0} lists them: "RST 3.1.1, Gantt-It 1.2.0".
